title: Getting Wealthy vs. Staying Wealthy
supportedClaims: Getting rich often rewards boldness, but staying rich rewards endurance, restraint, and survival.
A strategy that wins attention on the way up can fail badly if it does not leave enough margin to survive luck, ego, and shocks on the way forward.
The practical shift is to choose durable plans, lower ruin risk, and respect the value of still being in the game tomorrow.
caution: Conservative does not mean timid. It means building a plan that can absorb reality without forcing a panic rewrite.
